```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

pacman::p_load(
  here,
  tidyverse,
  maptiles,
  ggspatial,
  sf,
  mapview,
  here
)

```

# Satelite Basemap 
```{r}
# Bounding box of Biscayne Bay
bb_bbox <- st_bbox(c(
  xmin = -80.46, 
  ymin =  25.3,  
  xmax = -80.05, 
  ymax =  25.7   
), crs = st_crs(4326))

bb_poly <- st_as_sfc(bb_bbox)

basemap <- get_tiles(bb_poly, provider = "Esri.WorldImagery", zoom = 11)
```

# Biscayne Bay National Park Polygon 
```{r}
bb_np <- st_read(here("data", "raw", "key_biscayne_np", "BISC_tracts.shp"))

bb_np_crop <- bb_np %>% 
  st_transform(st_crs(bb_bbox)) %>% 
  st_make_valid() %>% 
  st_crop(bb_bbox)

ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = bb_np, color = "pink", fill = "pink") +
  theme_minimal()
```

# Vessle Tracking Heatmap 
```{r}
sent <- read_rds(file = here("data/processed/miami_dade_vessel_detections.rds"))

res <- 0.002 # In degrees

sent_grid <- sent |> 
  mutate(lon = (floor(lon / res) * res) + (res / 2),
         lat = (floor(lat / res) * res) + (res / 2)) |> 
  count(lon, lat) |> 
  collect()

sent_clean <- sent_grid %>%
  filter(n >= 2)

ggplot(sent_clean, aes(x = lon, y = lat)) + 
  geom_tile() + 
 # scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "inferno", direction = -1,  trans = "log10") + 
  coord_equal() +
  theme_bw()
```

# Seagrass Map (marine megafauna)
```{r, eval = FALSE}
seagrass <- st_read(here("data", "raw", "Seagrass_Habitat_in_Florida", "Seagrass_Habitat_in_Florida.shp"))

# Filtering the data to only include continuous seagrass polygons within the Biscayne Bay bounding box
seagrass_filt <- seagrass %>%
  filter(
    SEAGRASS == "Continuous"
  )

seagrass_crop <- seagrass %>% 
  filter(SEAGRASS == "Continuous") %>% 
  st_transform(st_crs(bb_bbox)) %>% 
  st_make_valid() %>% 
  st_crop(bb_bbox)

ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = seagrass_crop, color = "darkolivegreen", fill = "darkolivegreen") +
  theme_minimal()
```

# Coral Reef map 
```{r}
coral <- st_read(
  dsn = here("data", "raw", "UnifiedReefMap_v2_2", "commondata", "fwc_unifiedfloridareefmap_v2_2.gdb"), 
  layer = "UnifiedReefMap")

coral_crop <- coral %>% 
 filter(ClassLv1 %in% c("Aggregate Reef", "Individual or Aggregated Patch Reef")) %>%
  st_transform(st_crs(bb_bbox)) %>% 
  st_make_valid() %>% 
  st_crop(bb_bbox)

ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = coral_crop, color = "green", fill = "green") +
  theme_minimal()
```



## Map with all spatial layers
```{r}
ggplot() +
  
  ## Satelite basemap
  layer_spatial(basemap) +
  
  ## Nqtional park layer
  geom_sf(data = bb_np_crop, color = "pink", fill = "pink", linewidth = 0.8, aes(color = "Biscayne Bay NP")) +
  
  ## Seagrass layer
  geom_sf(data = coral_crop, fill = "greenyellow", color = "greenyellow", alpha = 0.6, linewidth = 0.1) +
  
  ## Vessle Tracking 
  geom_tile(data = sent_clean, aes(x = lon, y = lat), alpha = 0.5) +
  
  coord_sf(
    xlim = c(bb_bbox["xmin"], bb_bbox["xmax"]),
    ylim = c(bb_bbox["ymin"], bb_bbox["ymax"]),
    crs = st_crs(4326),
    expand = FALSE
  ) +
  
  annotation_scale(location = "bl", width_hint = 0.2, text_col = "white") +
  annotation_north_arrow(location = "tr", which_north = "true") +
  
  labs(
    title = "WAVES -- Biscayne Bay Map",
    x = "Longitude", 
    y = "Latitude"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    panel.grid = element_blank())
  
```
